title: Storm drain blockage observation
summary: A safe observation method for reporting blocked storm drains before or during heavy rain without stepping into moving water or opening covers.
content: This card keeps storm drain blockage observation practical: define the owner, protect the vulnerable point, make the result visible, and keep one review time. It is designed for phone use under stress, not for perfect paperwork. Core sequence: 1) Observe from a dry high edge and never stand in water to inspect a drain. 2) Record street, nearest building, water direction, depth estimate, and visible debris. 3) Photograph only if it does not place the observer in traffic or floodwater. 4) Report to the municipality or emergency channel and warn nearby pedestrians away from the low point. Stop point: Do not use storm drain blockage observation to justify entering a place that smells unsafe, sounds unstable, is electrically wet, or has been closed by authorities.
